intent: Adjusted body width to 0.16, wheel track to 0.16, and base speed to 0.55 to improve stability and reduce line loss events.
rationale: The current geometry has led to a high number of line loss events (3 in the first trial and 2 in the second). To improve stability and reduce control effort, I am adjusting the body width to 0.16 and the wheel track to 0.16. Additionally, I am increasing the base speed to 0.55 to enhance performance. These changes are expected to reduce line loss events and improve overall control during the trials.
